 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Jenny Johnson, president and CEO of one of the world's largest asset managers, Franklin Templeton. Jenny joined the business in 1988, and has worked in the organization ever since. In early 2020, she became CEO of Franklin, which now manages some 1.5 trillion in assets under management.
